title: The Point-Class Rank Functional under Birational Wall Crossing: Exact One-Wall Identities toward the X × P² Problem
description: This paper isolates the Gamma point row in quantum birational wall crossing. It proves an exact common-open point-column identity in the Gu--Yu--Yu quantum-D-module comparison for a smooth projective simple VGIT wall and a path-local point-row theorem for projective ordinary flops. It then gives an incomplete-Gamma countermodel showing that formal monodromy, a flat pairing, an integral Stokes lattice, and a length-three nilpotent projective-space tag do not determine the point row. Localized partial Fourier--Laplace discards the constant extension datum in this model, while a punctual module at a two-coordinate Fourier corner can transform back to a full-support module. The final result is a conditional factorization criterion: a two-wall transition preserves the row whenever every complete ray correction has rank-zero output target. A single signed punctual boundary coefficient is only a candidate shadow of those factorwise conditions; the required marked blockwise comparison is stated explicitly as open. For a smooth cubic threefold X, this is the unresolved assembly step in the point-row approach to X × P², and no irrationality statement for that product is asserted.
